questions: Are you having severe abdominal pain right now?
Did the abdominal pain begin suddenly?
Does the pain radiate to your back or sides?
Have you noticed a pulsating sensation or lump in your abdomen?
Did you faint, nearly faint, or suddenly become very weak?
Have you had dizziness, sweating, or shortness of breath?
Is your abdomen becoming rapidly larger or more tense?
Have you vomited or had persistent nausea?
Have you passed blood in your stool or vomited blood?
Have you been unable to pass stool or gas?
Have you had fever or chills?
Have you had a similar episode of abdominal pain before?
Have you ever been told that you have an abdominal aortic aneurysm?
Do you have high blood pressure, vascular disease, or a history of smoking?
Have you previously had abdominal surgery or a hernia?
